title: Custom Shell and Tube Heat Exchangers
summary: Tongyang manufactures custom shell-and-tube heat exchangers for industrial heating, cooling, condensation and heat recovery. Fixed-tubesheet, U-tube and floating-head configurations are reviewed against each project's process and mechanical requirements.
body:
Tongyang manufactures custom shell-and-tube heat exchangers in Yangzhou, China, for process heating, cooling, condensation and heat recovery. Each unit is engineered and fabricated around the approved thermal duty, mechanical design conditions, materials, installation constraints and inspection requirements. We supply equipment to industrial end users, EPC contractors and engineering partners.

Shell-and-Tube Exchanger Configurations

The appropriate configuration depends on thermal expansion, fouling, cleaning access, pressure drop, maintenance needs and the process specification.

ConfigurationTypical engineering considerations
Fixed tubesheetCompact construction where differential thermal expansion and shell-side cleaning requirements have been evaluated.
U-tubeAllows tube-bundle thermal expansion; tube-side mechanical cleaning access must be considered.
Floating headRemovable bundle arrangement for duties requiring improved access to both shell and tube sides, subject to mechanical design.

Other process heat-transfer equipment, including condensers, coolers and reboilers, can be reviewed based on the required duty.

Materials, Codes and Fabrication

  • Materials: carbon steel, SS304, SS316L and project-specified special alloys, selected for process chemistry, temperature and corrosion requirements.
  • Design basis: ASME Section VIII and relevant TEMA practices when specified and applicable; other regional requirements are assessed against the destination and agreed scope.
  • Quality control: material traceability, welding procedures, dimensional inspection, NDE, pressure or leak testing, third-party witnessing and final documentation as required by the approved inspection and test plan.
  • Engineering coordination: thermal rating and mechanical design responsibilities, performance requirements and deliverables are agreed during technical clarification.

Tongyang holds ASME U and U2 authorization for applicable pressure-vessel work. Certification or code stamping for a specific exchanger is determined by the agreed design and contractual requirements, not automatically assumed for every unit.

Industrial Applications

  • Chemical and petrochemical process heating and cooling
  • Oil and gas processing, gas conditioning and heat recovery
  • Condensers and reboilers for distillation and separation systems
  • Fertilizer, industrial gas and utility services
  • Thermal-oil, hot-water and other defined heat-transfer duties

Data Needed for a Technical Quotation

InformationWhat to provide
Process fluidsComposition, phase, flow rate and fouling characteristics of both streams
Thermal dutyInlet and outlet temperatures, heat load or available process data for thermal sizing
Design conditionsOperating and design pressures and temperatures for the shell and tube sides
Hydraulic limitsMaximum allowable pressure drops on both sides
Mechanical requirementsMaterials, corrosion allowance, dimensions, connection details and preferred configuration
Codes and inspectionApplicable standard, NDE, hydrotest, stamping and documentation requirements
Project interfacesQuantity, delivery destination, installation constraints and drawings or data sheets if available

If some values are not yet available, we can review the data provided and identify the remaining technical clarifications.

See our Heat Exchanger Data Sheet Guide or send your RFQ to Tongyang for project-specific review.

Final configuration, dimensions, performance responsibilities, certification and delivery are subject to the confirmed technical specification and agreed scope.
